summary: Tested Produk Serupa (backend and UI) and the 2 bug fixes. Backend: 11 of 11 new pytest pass. With the iter70/71 regression suites, 30 of 30 pass; 2 iter71 assertions were updated to match the intended new behaviour. Checked: GET /products/{id}/similar in auto mode (<=12 items, not itself, same category, Jombang items show the Jombang store_stock price), 404 for an unknown product. Editor GET/PUT: admin scope 'all'; invalid ids, self and duplicates are dropped; order is kept; max 30 (31 gives 422); 401 without auth; 404 for an unknown product. Jombang: scope pgs-jombang, inherited shows the admin list; the Jombang list overrides only for pgs-jombang buyers (Jember and Sidoarjo buyers keep the admin list); empty Jombang list falls back to the admin list; empty admin list falls back to auto. Jember editor shows the admin list as inherited. UI (390x844, real clicks; only location-lock hidden via JS): admin SimilarSection search, add 3, down/up, remove, save ('Produk serupa disimpan'), list kept after reload, API matches the UI order. /product/pgs-10062 shows the pd-similar rail at the bottom in the manual order. Jombang SimilarSection (on a Jombang-owned TEST product): inherited hint, add/up/remove/save, buyer gets the Jombang list; saving empty gives 'Kosong: memakai pilihan Super Admin / otomatis' and the inherited hint comes back. The new-product hint shows. Catalog-master: rename a brand with products, then Batal, reopens the sheet with the typed name (2 cycles); then 'Ya, ganti' gives 'Merek disimpan · 1 produk ikut diganti'; the Add sheet does not keep a stale draft. Excel import as jombang with an unknown brand: preview and commit give action create (not draft) with the Tanpa merek message, product brand '', brand not added; the update row also works (action update, brand cleared). MAIN GAP: branch admins have no UI to override Produk Serupa for shared-catalog products. All TEST data cleaned up; similar_products is empty; real data intact (115 brands, lainnya.count 0).

minor.issue: Code review, not verified at runtime because the seller has no active product. For a non-official seller, scope_of returns the seller's store_id, but buyer resolution only checks scope in (buyer branch, 'all'), and the branch is always an OFFICIAL_ID. So a seller's saved list is never used, while the editor says 'Produk serupa disimpan' and the subtitle says 'Khusus cabang Anda'. Reference: similar.py:23-28, 71-77; similar-section.tsx:41,47

Stock uses the ALL_BRANCHES total ('PGS · semua cabang'), not the buyer's branch stock; only the price is per branch. This matches Produk Populer, but the spec says 'buyer's branch price & stock'. Reference: similar.py:56,66
A branch admin can save a list for any product_id, including products their buyers cannot see. Harmless, but there is no visibility check. Reference: similar.py:97

integration_issues.flow: Branch admin override of Produk Serupa on shared catalog products
integration_issues.issue: Jombang owns 0 products. In product-editor/list.tsx:229, shared products open /seller/branch-prices, and /product-editor/pgs-10062 as jombang shows 'Produk tidak ditemukan' (product_editor.py:361 editable() filters by store_id). So the 'jombang list overrides for Jombang buyers' feature works only through the API, or on a branch's own (only_branch) products, which only that branch's buyers see anyway. Add the SimilarSection (or a link to it) to the branch-prices screen, or let branch admins open the editor read-only with SimilarSection for shared products.

issues: Search hits stay listed after adding items; the long list pushes the Save button down. Consider clearing the query after an add or limiting the hits.
Errors loading editorSimilar are swallowed (.catch(() => {})) and there is no loading state. Reference: similar-section.tsx:23
'Simpan Produk Serupa' saves on its own, separate from 'Simpan Perubahan'. Unsaved section changes are lost silently if the user only taps the main save. Consider a dirty warning.
Not part of this feature: the 'Simpan Draft' label wraps to 2 lines in its pill when the delete icon is shown at 390px.

action_items: HIGH: Give branch admins a UI path to set the Produk Serupa override for shared PGS catalog products (e.g. SimilarSection on /seller/branch-prices, or editor access for shared products limited to SimilarSection). Today the branch override can only be set via the API.
Regular sellers: either apply the seller-scope list for their own products in resolution (e.g. check doc.store_id scope), or hide the section or change its text for non-official sellers.
Optional: clear the search after adding, show a load error state, and warn about unsaved Produk Serupa changes.
critical_code_review_comments: similar.py resolution (branch -> 'all' -> auto), dedupe, self-exclusion, invalid-id drop and empty-means-delete are correct and verified.
Manual items are filtered by the buyer's visibility (base query), so hidden or inactive products are dropped. If all are dropped, it correctly falls back to auto.
product_bulk.py: the update and create paths both clear the unknown brand to '' with a note, for branch admins only; Super Admin commit still creates the brand (iter71 test still passes).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_pgs_iter71_catalog_master.py (updated 2 assertions for intended new behaviour: products_moved counts only products that land in Lainnya; branch-admin import of an unknown brand now creates as Tanpa merek)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows; 1 integration gap (branch override UI for shared products)
